title: Hope of Salvation
definition: Hope of Salvation is the confident expectation that God will complete the saving work He began in Christ.
summary: The Hope of Salvation is the confident expectation that God will complete the rescue He began in Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the living hope of His people and the guarantee of their coming glory.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine looks forward without uncertainty because hope is grounded in God's promise, not wishful thinking. Believers wait for full deliverance, resurrection, and glory because Christ has already secured their salvation. Hope steadies the heart between present struggle and future completion.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because believers often face suffering, weakness, and unfinished sanctification. Hope keeps them from despair and from settling for this present age as their final home. It teaches endurance with eyes fixed on Christ's return and final redemption.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Practice hope by rehearsing God's promises when circumstances are heavy. Encourage weary believers that salvation has a future as well as a past. Let hope produce endurance, purity, and worship.
